$description: The video site template's own component tokens: each aliases a core semantic role, so its parts follow the theme and every context.

gap.$description: Between video columns: 16 (C-1280-L x131 + 347.3 to x494.3).

feed-inset.$description: Feed beside the mini guide: grid from x96, 24 after the 72 guide (T-1280-L, S-1280-L).

feed-inset-guide.$description: Feed beside the 240 guide: content from x256 (H-1440-L).

radius.$description: Guide entries, expanded and mini: radius 10, the theme's medium radius (G-1280-L, H-1280-L).

mini-entry-width.$description: Mini entry 64 wide inside the 72 mini guide (H-1280-L).

mini-gap.$description: Mini entry: icon to label 6 (76 − 16 − 24 − 16 − 14, H-1280-L).

mini-inset-block-start.$description: The mini guide starts 4 below the masthead: first entry at y60 (H-1280-L).

prompt-inset.$description: Sign-in prompt text at x33: 12 section padding + 20 (G-1280-L).
